subject: Re: Kickoff: C-Learning - staffing + compute reservation
body:
Ulla,

Staffing: Halima 70% (TL), Gustavo 60% on the classifier training loop and ablations, Oyin 40% on the sim-platform integration path. That holds through the window.

Compute: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation for the week of 2026-06-22 - 512 accelerators from the agents-rl quarterly allocation. The full goal-sampling-ratio ablation runs that week, so the sweep configs must be frozen by Jun 17. Before then, M1 repro runs fine on titan-a100 best-effort; the MuJoCo environments are the bottleneck, not the networks.

One infra note: the mujoco200 install with the libGL symlink dance is fragile on our base images. Oyin is baking a container this week so the whole team stops fighting it - budget half a day each to migrate.

Also: if the ablation slips past June, we run into Q3 allocation negotiations and I can't promise the same accelerator count. Jun 17 freeze is the real deadline here.

Jelena
